gates.description: All infrastructure must be defined in IaC (Terraform/Pulumi/CloudFormation)
No hardcoded secrets, passwords, or API keys in IaC files
Encryption at rest and in transit must be configured for all data stores
Backup policy must be configured with automated, tested, encrypted backups
Automated drift detection must be configured (daily scan)
IAM policies must follow least privilege — no wildcard permissions

anti_patterns.description: Creating infrastructure through the cloud console — if it's not in code, it doesn't exist
All infrastructure in a single Terraform state file — one mistake could destroy unrelated production resources
Every environment is slightly different with undocumented manual changes — configuration drift is guaranteed
IP addresses, AMI IDs, account IDs hard-coded in Terraform — any change requires find-and-replace
Deploying infrastructure changes with terraform apply to everything at once — one mistake affects all services

escalation_triggers: Infrastructure change causes service outage or degradation
Security vulnerability discovered in infrastructure configuration (public S3 bucket, open security group)
Cloud provider outage affecting hosted infrastructure
Infrastructure costs deviating significantly from projections
IaC state corruption requiring manual intervention
Compliance audit finding related to infrastructure configuration

input_requirements.description: Spec.md with infrastructure requirements and security policy

output_certifications: All infrastructure defined in IaC (no console-created resources)
No hardcoded secrets in any configuration files
Encryption at rest and in transit configured for all data stores
Backup policy configured, automated, and tested
IAM policies follow least privilege (no wildcard permissions)
